techniques.name: Retrieval Practice
techniques.description: The act of recalling information from memory to enhance and reinforce learning. It strengthens memory and improves long-term retention.
tasks: Encourage students to recall information rather than reviewing notes.
Use retrieval practice to reinforce learning.

techniques.name: Spacing and Interleaving
techniques.description: Spacing involves spreading out learning over time, while interleaving involves mixing different topics or skills within a single study session.
tasks: Schedule lessons and review sessions to revisit topics over time.
Mix different types of problems or subjects within practice sessions.
Enhance learning by spacing and interleaving practice.

techniques.name: Deliberate Practice
techniques.description: Focused, goal-oriented practice aimed at improving specific aspects of performance. It involves setting clear goals, receiving feedback, and continuously refining skills.
tasks: Design practice activities that target specific skills or knowledge areas.
Encourage students to reflect and adjust their approach.

techniques.name: Quizzing and Testing
techniques.description: Using quizzes and tests as learning tools, not just assessments. Regular testing helps reinforce memory and identify areas that need further study.
tasks: Incorporate frequent, low-stakes quizzes to assess understanding.
Reinforce learning with regular quizzing and testing.
Use test results to inform future instruction.

techniques.name: Distributed Practice
techniques.description: Spreading out study sessions over time rather than cramming. It improves retention and helps students build stronger connections between concepts.
tasks: Plan study sessions and review activities across multiple lessons.
Ensure students revisit and practice material at regular intervals.
